review.callbackRetirement: One independent pass and targeted confirmation; queued promise/timer findings reproduced and fixed, including detached-frame sibling.
review.documentAndInitialContext: One independent pass and targeted confirmation; live popup-name lookup finding reproduced and fixed.
review.sandboxedForms: One independent pass and targeted confirmation; rejected native asynchronous submission and runtime argument precedence findings reproduced and fixed.
review.incrementalParser: Independent native pass and targeted confirmation; script lifetime, stylesheet barriers, token-boundary emission and generation/cancellation ordering addressed. Full native input modes pass.
review.popupSessionLifetime: Independent runtime pass and targeted confirmation; window event origin checks/receiver forwarding, timer callback realm ownership and module settlement isolation reproduced and fixed. Confirmation found no remaining actionable findings.

limits: Full runtime suite was not reported as passing.
Reverse about:blank/srcdoc child-to-parent URL/base behavior is not qualified for browser equivalence.
Popup navigation, window features, noopener/noreferrer and sandbox escape are unsupported.
Long unfinished lexical tokens supplied through many small writes have not been performance-qualified.
These checks do not execute the upstream web-platform-test suite or qualify general browser compatibility.
macOS arm64 validation does not establish a complete cross-platform runtime gate.
validationNotes: One concurrent broad runtime run had154pass/15timeout failures. Every affected class passed sequentially without changing deadlines; full runtime suite is not claimed as passing.
Four review regressions reproduced before remediation: cross-origin window event access, stale opener listener target, retired-root timer on popup, and popup module blocking root reload.

One combined-render attempt threw an unlocalized null-reference error before an explicit readiness wait was added. Three diagnostic reruns passed without a product-code change; the final harness now waits for root/frame readiness and passes. This does not establish an exhaustive diagnosis of that transient failure.

forkPatch.contract: Incremental script-created document input; retained on integration fork. Not submitted as a standalone upstream PR because extraction must account for preceding document lifecycle/reentry changes.

inputStreamUrlCheckpoint.review: One independent read-only pass found no actionable issue. Worker cross-origin writes and two-entry history behavior were then added as focused tests and passed.
inputStreamUrlCheckpoint.scope: Adapted entry-document URL and history checks, including implicit write and writeln opening; no official WPT harness run.
remaining: The WPT synchronous-call case invokes a child-defined window function from the parent; arbitrary cross-realm window function forwarding remains unsupported.
The WPT popup history case and the wider input-stream suite are not qualified by the root history tests.
